name: webhook-co
description: Diagnose why an inbound webhook signature is failing, using the open registry of 144 provider schemes behind webhook.co.

interface.longDescription: Work out why an inbound webhook signature won't verify. The failure modes look identical from the outside and have completely different fixes: the wrong secret, a body your framework re-serialized before you saw it, a timestamp outside the replay window, or a provider whose signed message isn't what you'd guess. This walks you to a specific diagnosis using the open Apache-2.0 registry of 144 provider schemes that webhook.co is built on.
defaultPrompt: My Stripe webhook signature check keeps failing and I don't know why
Verify this webhook payload against my signing secret
